Some monsters that know magic awaken as true spellcasters, marked [Mage].

A Mage casts its spells one after another, and backs away when you come close. It only fights with its hands once its mana runs low.

How to fight it: close the distance fast, silence it, or drain its mana. Archers and mages can outrange it.

A Mage drops more loot than its kin, and always leaves a Sealed Cache behind - look on the ground where it fell.
